Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and onboarding artifacts

Hi Priyom,

Hope you’re well — I’m Elena from Acme Health (security team). We’ve started our vendor security intake for a pilot partnership and need your current SOC 2 Type II report covering the last 12 months, or if that isn’t available, a bridge letter describing the audit status and expected delivery.

Alongside the report/bridge letter we typically ask for:
- Primary audit period covered (start/end dates)
- List of in-scope systems and data flows
- Evidence for key controls (user access review, change management entries, incident response post-mortems)

Can you confirm what you can share and any timelines? Our procurement window is tight — ideally we’d have documents within two weeks. If useful, we can also share our SIG questionnaire after the initial items.

Thanks,
Elena Ramos
Sr. Information Security Manager | Acme Health
elena.ramos@acmehealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

---
Note: please send documents via the secure SFTP link we provided in the intake form or a secure Drive share.

Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and onboarding artifacts

Hi Elena — thanks for reaching out and for the clear ask. We can support the request. Summary below of what we can provide immediately and next steps.

What we can provide right away (attached):
- SOC2_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf — short list of typical artifacts, owners, and expected delivery windows
- SOC2_BridgeLetter_Template.docx — editable bridge letter if our latest Type II is still in processing for your audit window
- requested_artifact_list.csv — mapping of commonly requested artifacts to Redwood owners

To confirm a couple of items so we give you the right files:
1) Audit period: Do you need the full 12-month Type II period (e.g., 2025-07-01 -> 2026-06-30) or a shorter rolling 12-month slice?
2) Delivery channel: We can upload sensitive materials to your SFTP or share via a secure Drive link with access expiration. Which do you prefer?
3) SIG/CAIQ: We can accept the questionnaire, but for initial procurement we find the SOC 2 artifacts + bridge letter (if needed) cover the compliance bar. We’ll then map the SIG controls to SOC coverage.

If the Type II is not yet finalized, we’ll populate the bridge letter with audit firm and expected completion date; if it’s available we’ll share the report and the bridge will be marked N/A. We aim to surface the initial bundle within 3 business days once you confirm the audit period and delivery method.

Looping in Marissa (Security Comms) to coordinate artifacts and Vivek (Engineering Compliance) on any infra-level evidence. If there are specific control IDs or a preferred artifact list you want prioritized, send that and we’ll triage.

Best,
Priyom Das
Director, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0210

Attachments: SOC2_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf, SOC2_BridgeLetter_Template.docx, requested_artifact_list.csv

Thanks, Priyom — that sounds good. A couple clarifications:
- Audit period we’d like to see is "most recent completed Type II period" (our procurement checklist expects the latest completed 12 months). If you have a report covering Jul 1, 2025 — Jun 30, 2026 that’s ideal.
- Delivery: secure Drive link works for us. Please set link expiration to 14 days and limit to view-only for external addresses.
- Priorities: user access reviews (last two quarters), change management tickets for the same period, and your INCIDENT_RESPONSE_POSTMORTEMS folder (redacted as needed). If you have an exec summary or SOC 2 cover letter that’s helpful too.

If you’re able to provide a bridge letter, please include the expected date the final report will be issued and the auditor firm name. If the report is already final, please include the cover letter + auditor opinion page (these help our security & legal teams).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our internal deadline for legal sign-off is 2026-12-18.

Elena
